company.name: AlphaPharm Nutrition
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Protein bars in a Snacks, Bars & Drinks section, cream of rice and sports supplements from Applied Nutrition, NPL, TNT Mercury and others
company.channels_supplied: One store in Randburg and its own online shop with nationwide delivery
company.fit_rationale: A multi-brand sports nutrition shop with its own snacks and bars section for gym shoppers. Diablo's sugar-free bars, cookies and spreads fit there. Small, one store; bar brands not named on its home page.

company.name: Anadea
company.distributes: Chocolates, biscuits and rusks, chips and crackers, nut butters and spreads, syrups and sweeteners, cereals and mueslis, plus supplements and natural care
company.channels_supplied: Its own natural health store in Century City, Cape Town, and its online shop with nationwide delivery
company.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you brands such as Wazoogles, Buttanutt, Health Connection Wholefoods and Soaring Free Superfoods; no direct sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Stocks around 200 natural health brands, bought direct from brands and distributors.
Delivers nationwide with same-day collection at its Century City store.
company.fit_rationale: A natural health store and online shop with its own Snacks section (chocolates, biscuits and rusks) and a Butters and Spreads section, all from other brands. It says it buys direct from brands and distributors and carries around 200 brands, so Diablo's vegan spreads, chocolate and biscuits fit its shelf.

company.name: Balans Health
company.channel: Gluten free and free from shops
company.distributes: Sweets and chocolates, protein and snack bars, spreads and snacks, plus health foods, cereals and sweeteners
company.channels_supplied: Own shop in Brandwag, Bloemfontein and its online shop with nationwide delivery
company.sf_brands_carried: Caring Candies (sugar free sweets and chocolate), Wedgewood Nougat
what_they_do_well: Stocks around 100 health brands, all described as approved by dietitians and nutritional specialists, with free nationwide delivery over R400.
company.fit_rationale: A dietitian-approved health shop with its own Sweets and Chocolates, Protein and Snack Bars and Spreads categories from many other brands, including the sugar free Caring Candies range. Diablo's sugar free chocolate, sweets and bars fit its shelf directly. Store count beyond its Bloemfontein shop is not stated on its website.

company.name: Bash (TFG)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Racefood (Fastbar and Farbar) and sports nutrition from 32Gi and Gloot in its sports and wellness departments
company.channels_supplied: Online shop of TFG, selling for chains including Totalsports and Sportscene
what_they_do_well: Sells for 19 TFG store brands, including Totalsports and Sportscene, from one online shop.
company.fit_rationale: TFG's online store sells sports goods for Totalsports and Sportscene and already lists Racefood bars and 32Gi nutrition. Diablo's bars and sugar-free snacks would sit alongside them for sport shoppers. Head office city taken from TFG's public profile; food range is small.

company.name: Bicycle Line
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Cadence Carbofuel energy bars and gels
company.channels_supplied: Cycling shop and coffee bar, and its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: A cycling shop that sells Cadence energy bars in its nutrition section. Diablo's bars suit its riders. Small, one bar brand; location from the Cadence Nutrition retailer list.

company.name: Big Five Duty Free
company.distributes: Duty free retail of liquor, fragrance, cosmetics, tobacco, accessories and confectionery, including chocolate (for example Amarula chocolate and milk chocolate lines)
company.channels_supplied: Its own duty free stores in international departures and arrivals at OR Tambo, Cape Town, King Shaka and Lanseria airports, plus online pre-order with in-store collection
what_they_do_well: Described by the Moodie Davitt Report in October 2025 as Sub-Saharan Africa's leading travel retail operator.
Launched Distell's Amarula chocolate in its airport stores (2023).
company.fit_rationale: The leading duty free operator in South Africa, with stores at the four main international airports and confectionery named as one of its core categories on its own About page. Gebr. Heinemann is a co-shareholder, bringing global confectionery buying, and the OR Tambo revamp is premiumising the confectionery offer, which suits Diablo's gift boxes, chocolate and seasonal packs. No sugar-free range is shown on its website.

company.name: Biket
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Cadence and PowerBar, plus gels and drink mixes
company.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Hillcrest, KwaZulu-Natal, and its own online shop with nationwide delivery
company.fit_rationale: A Trek approved cycling shop with a cycling nutrition section that sells bars from other brands. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars suit its riders. Small, one store.

company.name: Cake Princess
company.distributes: Imported snacks and sweets, viral sweets, cookies (Lotus Biscoff), chocolate and gifts
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop with delivery and pick up; stores at Cape Gate Lifestyle Centre, Brackenfell and Laguna Mall, Langebaan
what_they_do_well: Runs two candy stores, at Cape Gate Lifestyle Centre and Laguna Mall, alongside its online shop.
company.fit_rationale: A candy store selling imported branded sweets and snacks to shoppers online and in two Western Cape stores. Diablo's sweets, chocolate and biscuits suit its imported treats shelf. Tier 3 because it is small, with two stores, and its website names few brands.

company.name: Cape Union Mart
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Snacks and energy bars in its Snacks & Nutrition section, including Racefood bars
company.channels_supplied: Own outdoor and adventure stores in malls across South Africa (Canal Walk, Cavendish, Fourways Mall, Woodlands) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Racefood lists Cape Union Mart among its national retailers for energy bars.
company.fit_rationale: A national outdoor and travel chain with its own Snacks & Nutrition category, and Racefood names it as a stockist of its bars. Diablo's muesli bars, cookies and sugar-free sweets suit hikers and travellers. Products in the category did not load in this run, so brands beyond Racefood are not listed here.

company.name: Corporate Vending
company.distributes: Snack vending stocked with branded snacks, chocolates and drinks
company.channels_supplied: Office and hotel vending for clients such as Woolworths, Old Mutual, Nedbank, Standard Bank, Discovery Health and Marriott Protea
what_they_do_well: Running fully outsourced vending since 1994.
Client logos include Woolworths, Old Mutual, Nedbank, Standard Bank and Discovery Health.
company.fit_rationale: Full-service vending operator that stocks its machines with A-grade branded snacks and drinks across the Western Cape. Diablo's bars and chocolate suit workplace snack vending. Its website does not name the snack brands it stocks. Storage: buys and holds the stock it fills machines with, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Cycleway
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars, gels and chews from 32Gi, Cadence and PowerBar in a Bars & Gels section
company.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Polokwane and its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: A cycling shop with its own Bars & Gels nutrition section that sells other brands. Diablo's bars and sugar-free gummies suit its riders. Small, one store.

company.name: DS International Nutrition
company.distributes: Protein bars (Barebells) and a health food and snacks category, alongside sports nutrition and vitamins from imported brands such as NOW Foods, MuscleTech and Cellucor
company.channels_supplied: Dis-Chem, Wellness Warehouse, Takealot, Xtreme Nutrition, Faithful to Nature and SPAR, over 800 stores
company.sf_brands_carried: Barebells no added sugar protein bars, TRU Hydration zero sugar; no direct competitor in sugar-free confectionery seen
what_they_do_well: Brought Barebells protein bars into South African retail, now on Dis-Chem shelves.
Covers all nine provinces with its own trucks between Durban, Cape Town and Johannesburg.
company.fit_rationale: A distributor of international health and sports nutrition brands that launches foreign brands in South Africa and sells bars and snacks into the pharmacy and health chains Diablo wants. It offers customs clearance, sales coverage in all nine provinces and its own truck fleet. Storage: own on-site warehouse certified for food handling.

company.name: Fabulous Flowers and Gifts
company.distributes: Chocolate and sweets gift boxes (Lindt, Lindt Lindor, Ferrero Rocher), luxury biscuits, nougat, jams and snack hampers
company.channels_supplied: Own shops in Claremont, Cavendish Square and Sea Point, a Johannesburg branch, nationwide online delivery and corporate accounts
what_they_do_well: Hand-packing chocolate and sweets boxes in its Claremont studio since 1999, with over 5,000 customer reviews.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town gifting business with its own shops, a Johannesburg branch and corporate accounts for banks, law firms and agencies, whose chocolate and sweets boxes are built on Lindt and Ferrero Rocher. Shelf-stable boxes ship nationwide, which suits Diablo's ambient gift boxes. Its sister brand Flower Guy sells the same kind of hampers with Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury and Darling Sweet.

company.name: FELFEL
company.distributes: Branded packaged snacks and chocolate snacks (Kinder), crisps (Zweifel) and drinks through its USEGO office snack service, plus fresh meals, fruit boxes and coffee
company.channels_supplied: Offices and workplaces across Switzerland and Liechtenstein through smart fridges and its USEGO snack and drinks service
what_they_do_well: Swiss family-run workplace catering business founded in Zurich in 2013, serving Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
company.fit_rationale: FELFEL was founded in Zurich and its USEGO service restocks offices weekly with popular snacks and drinks from top brands such as Kinder and Zweifel, sold to employees as they are. Diablo's chocolate, bars and biscuits would suit its health-led workplace offer. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Hamper World
company.distributes: Sweets and chocolate hampers with Zanoni Chocolate, Chocoloza, Darling Sweet, fudge and gourmet popcorn
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers with same-day delivery in Gauteng and nationwide delivery; gifts for colleagues and thank-you hampers
company.fit_rationale: An online hamper shop with dedicated sweets and chocolate hamper categories filled with other brands such as Zanoni, Chocoloza and Darling Sweet. It says it prefers brands with natural ingredients, which suits Diablo's stevia and no-added-sugar positioning. Head office address is not stated on its website.

company.name: Health Island
company.channel: Diabetic, low sugar and keto shops
company.distributes: Healthy snacks for diabetic, sugar free and low carb customers: snack bars, baked biscuits and rusks, nut and fruit mixes, savoury snacks and nougat in snack boxes and hampers, plus healthy vending
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, corporate snack boxes and hampers delivered across South Africa, and healthy vending machines run through franchisees
what_they_do_well: Runs healthy vending machines through a franchise model as well as nationwide snack box and hamper delivery.
company.fit_rationale: A healthy snack business that sources products from suppliers across the country and sells them as snack boxes, hampers and through healthy vending, with options for diabetic, sugar free and low carb customers. Diablo's bars, cookies and wafers suit its boxes and vending machines. Tier 3 because its website does not name the bar and biscuit brands it carries and gives no store or machine count.

company.name: HealthTwin Supplements & Vitamins
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Barebells protein bars, Creme Supreme and Gloot products, sports nutrition and vitamins
company.channels_supplied: One store at Mall @ Reds, Centurion, and its own online shop with delivery across South Africa
company.fit_rationale: An independent sports nutrition retailer that sells Barebells protein bars and other brands to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's sugar-free bars and cookies fit its shelf. Small, one store.

company.name: HealthWell Brands
company.distributes: Imported better-for-you brands: protein bars (Better Bar), plastic-free chewing gum, peanut butter and spreads (Whole Earth), superfoods, honey and organic drinks
company.channels_supplied: Pick n Pay, Dis-Chem, Clicks, SPAR, Food Lover's Market, Wellness Warehouse, Faithful to Nature, Jackson's and over 245 independent health shops and pharmacies
what_they_do_well: Places brands in Clicks, Dis-Chem, SPAR and Pick n Pay with its own sales reps in the main centres.
Founded as Harrewyn Organics in 2004, rebranded HealthWell Brands in 2020.
company.fit_rationale: Builds foreign natural and wellness brands in South Africa, offering market entry, regulatory support, national distribution and marketing to its principals. Its bars, gum and peanut butter reach the pharmacy and health chains that suit Diablo's health-conscious shoppers. Storage: primary warehouse and distribution centre in Cape Town, with further warehouses in Johannesburg.

company.name: HH Foods Distributors
company.distributes: Imported and local sweets, gummies, lollipops, biscuits and chips from brands such as Jovy and N&F
company.channels_supplied: Retailers and wholesalers across South Africa
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2006, sourcing sweets and snacks from six countries.
company.fit_rationale: Distributor that supplies imported and local snacks, sweets and confectionery to retailers and wholesalers nationally, sourcing from Turkey, Brazil, India, Dubai, China and Malaysia. Its trade customer base covers the independent shops Diablo wants to reach. Storage: sells from its own stock in Blackheath, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: IBA Coastal
company.distributes: Imported American chocolates and candy, snacks and popcorn, biscuits, confectionery and beverages (Reese's, Hershey's, Sour Patch Kids, Mike and Ike, Cheetos)
company.channels_supplied: Supermarkets, cash and carry stores, forecourts, tuck shops, canteens and independent retailers, naming SuperSPAR, SPAR Express, Focus, Looters and Bargain Basket
what_they_do_well: Supplies SuperSPAR, SPAR Express, Looters and Bargain Basket stores.
Imports over 200 American products through an import partner of more than 30 years.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run B2B distributor that imports over 200 American products and supplies them at wholesale prices to supermarkets, forecourts and tuck shops across KwaZulu-Natal, with courier delivery nationally. Chocolate, sweets and biscuits are core categories. Storage: sells from its own stock with its own deliveries, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: JOC Cycles
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Amacx, PowerBar and Racefood, with Neversecond and Maurten bar sections
company.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Mouille Point, Cape Town, and its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: A premium cycling store with an energy bars section from several brands. Diablo's bars fit next to them. Small, one store.

company.name: Kingdoms Wholesale
company.distributes: Gummies and jelly sweets (sweet and sour worms, jelly mix, fruit pastels, sour rings) in cartons for resale
company.channels_supplied: Independent retailers, spaza shops, tuck shops and convenience stores in Cape Town
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town wholesaler built to supply spaza shops, tuck shops and convenience stores, the core kiosk channel. Tier 3 because it is small, its range is narrow and its website does not name the brands it carries. Storage: sells from its own stock with delivery to qualifying areas, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Kit Kat Group (Kit Kat Cash and Carry)
company.distributes: Groceries and FMCG with web shop categories for sweets, chocolate products, snack foods and sweet and snacks
company.channels_supplied: Traders, spaza shops and households through cash and carry stores and Express stores in Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga, plus an online store
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1953, with wholesale since 1983; now runs 6 cash and carry stores, 19 Express stores and 3 Express cash and carry stores.
company.fit_rationale: A family-owned cash and carry group whose own web shop lists sweets, chocolate and snack categories sold in trade pack sizes to traders and shoppers. Its stores feed many independent and informal retailers in Gauteng and Limpopo, a direct route to spaza and tuck shop shelves. Storage: cash and carry stores, including a 20,000 m2 Pretoria West site, served by its own fleet of warehouse trucks.

company.name: KosherWorld
company.distributes: Kosher supermarket range including a chocolate and sweets department, snacks and groceries
company.channels_supplied: Supermarket in Glenhazel, Johannesburg and an online store at shop.kosherworld.co.za; an OK Franchise Division member
what_they_do_well: Describes itself as the only truly kosher supermarket in South Africa, trading seven days a week outside Shabbat.
company.fit_rationale: A kosher supermarket with its own online store and a chocolate and sweets department, serving the Johannesburg Jewish community. Many Diablo products are kosher, so its sweets and chocolate shelves suit Diablo's range. Tier 3 because it is a single supermarket and its chocolate department page did not open.

company.name: KR Sweets
company.distributes: Imported sweets and chocolates from manufacturers in Brazil, Tunisia, Pakistan and China (Jelly Fun, Gomets, Dori, JOJO)
company.channels_supplied: Retailers through a wholesale line, plus direct sales to shoppers; shop types not named on its website
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town import and distribution company that sources branded sweets and chocolates abroad and sells them wholesale to retailers. It is small and its website does not name the shops it supplies. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: KZN Vending
company.distributes: Snacks and chocolate from brands such as Simba, Nestle, Cadbury and Beacon in snack, combination and cold drink machines on its own vending routes
company.channels_supplied: Placed snack machines on vending routes throughout KwaZulu-Natal
what_they_do_well: Has established vending routes throughout KwaZulu-Natal and is Merseta accredited for its repair work.
company.fit_rationale: Specialises in the placement of snack machines and runs its own vending routes throughout KwaZulu-Natal, affiliated with Simba, Nestle, Cadbury and Beacon. It is tier 3 because its website does not show how many machines it runs or name its clients. Storage: sells from its own stock on its routes, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: LuluLocal
company.distributes: Curated gifts with sweets and chocolates, biscuits and rusks, and dried fruit and savoury snacks from local brands
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online and corporate gifting for year-end, conferences and activations nationwide
what_they_do_well: Holds its own stock for fast daily turnaround and scales to conference and year-end gifting projects.
company.fit_rationale: An online gift shop and corporate gifting service that sells other South African brands' sweets, chocolates and biscuits and builds bespoke corporate boxes. It holds its own stock for daily turnaround and handles nationwide delivery, so it can take a branded imported range. Head office address and warehouse are not named on its website; it states that it holds stock.

company.name: MA Powertrade Cash & Carry
company.distributes: Confectionery, sweets, chocolates, biscuits, chips and drinks, alongside groceries and household goods
company.channels_supplied: Small supermarkets, corner cafes, tuck shops and spaza shops in the Cape Flats, plus walk-in shoppers; member of the UMS Powertrade symbol group
what_they_do_well: Trading for 35 years from Athlone, Cape Town, serving tuck shops, cafes and spaza shops.
company.fit_rationale: An owner-run cash and carry in Athlone that supplies corner cafes, tuck shops and spaza shops with sweets, chocolates and biscuits. Its membership of the UMS Powertrade group links it to other independent wholesalers. Storage: sells from its own cash and carry store in Rylands, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Macgrif (Endurofix)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars (USN, Vooma, Racefood, Naak), energy waffles, chews and gummies (GU), gels and drink mixes
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with delivery across South Africa
company.sf_brands_carried: USN Zero Sugar hydrator and HIGH5 Zero tabs (drinks only); no sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Stocks nine endurance brands including GU, HIGH5, Naak, Never Second, Racefood and 32Gi with 1 to 3 day delivery.
company.fit_rationale: An online endurance nutrition shop with separate bars, waffles and chews and gummies sections from many brands, sold nationwide. Diablo's muesli bars, wafers and sugar-free gummies fit its range for runners and cyclists.

company.name: Market Anatolia
company.distributes: Confectionery section with chocolate, biscuits, wafers and sweets from Ulker, Eti, Solen, Haribo, Galaxy and Nutella spreads, plus jam and Turkish grocery
company.channels_supplied: Trade only: retailers, cash and carries, wholesalers and foodservice across Southern Africa, with nationwide delivery
what_they_do_well: Supplies branded Ulker and Eti biscuits and confectionery by the case to retailers and cash and carries nationwide.
company.fit_rationale: A trade-only importer and wholesaler since 2017 whose own catalogue has a confectionery section of branded biscuits, wafers, chocolate and sweets sold by the case to retailers and cash and carries. Diablo's halal certificate and biscuits sit well beside Ulker and Eti. Storage: warehouse in Montague Gardens, Cape Town.

company.name: NetFlorist
company.distributes: Chocolate gift boxes, hat boxes, crates, towers and truffles (Lindt, Nestle, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury), nougat (Sally Williams), candy jars, cookies and snack hampers
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate buyers nationwide through its own online shop and delivery network
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1999 and runs its own warehouses and in-house delivery hubs in four South African cities.
company.fit_rationale: South Africa's largest online gifting business, with chocolate and snack hampers built from other companies' brands such as Lindt, Ferrero Rocher and Cadbury. A branded sugar-free chocolate box or variety pack would sit naturally in its chocolate gift categories. Storage: own warehouses in Johannesburg and Cape Town, with in-house logistics hubs in Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria and Johannesburg.

company.name: OfficeBox
company.distributes: Office supplies with a kitchen and breakroom range: biscuits (Bakers, Mantellis, Eet-Sum-Mor), chocolate and sweets (Nestle Bar One, Endearmints, Beacon), cereal and energy bars (Jungle), peanut butter (Black Cat) and savoury snacks (Simba, Lay's).
company.channels_supplied: Businesses and offices through its online shop and B2B procurement accounts, with next-day delivery in Johannesburg and Cape Town and national delivery to multi-branch clients such as Virgin Active and Burger King.
what_they_do_well: Supplies multi-branch clients nationally; testimonials cite Virgin Active (155 branches) and Burger King (95 stores).
Next-day delivery in Johannesburg and Cape Town for orders placed by 9:30am.
company.fit_rationale: An online office supplier with a 55-item biscuits and snacks collection of other companies' brands, sold to offices and multi-branch businesses nationally. Diablo's biscuits, chocolate, bars and spreads sit in the exact shelf it already runs for office kitchens. Storage: sells from its own stock of 6,500+ products with next-day delivery, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Olympic Cycles
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Amacx, Cadence, Enduren, GU, HIGH5, Isostar, Maurten, Nutritech, PowerBar, Racefood and Voom, plus gels
company.channels_supplied: Two cycling stores (Claremont and Kenilworth) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Runs one of the widest bar ranges seen in South African cycling retail, with eleven bar brands.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town cycling retailer with a dedicated bars collection of eleven brands sold online nationwide. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars would fit this shelf. Only two stores are shown.

company.name: ONEG Candy
company.distributes: Imported branded chocolate, sweets, gummies, snacks and drinks from the US and UK, such as Hershey's, Reese's, Jelly Belly and Sour Patch Kids
company.channels_supplied: Retailers and confectionery stores; names Checkers, Pick n Pay, SPAR and Engen as clients
what_they_do_well: Names Checkers, Pick n Pay, SPAR and Engen as clients for its imported US and UK confectionery.
company.fit_rationale: An importer and distributor of premium foreign confectionery and snacks since 2015 that already places imported brands in Checkers, Pick n Pay, SPAR and Engen forecourts. A UK sugar-free chocolate and sweets range fits its imported premium positioning. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Ridgeway Cycles
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: NamedSport energy bars and Cadence nutrition in its supplements section
company.channels_supplied: Cycling stores in Greenstone and Edenvale, Johannesburg, and its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: A cycling retailer that sells energy bars from other brands to riders. Diablo's bars fit this shelf. Small range.

contacts.job_title: Senior Vice President: Downstream Energy Marketing & Sales & Managing Director of Sasol Oil

company.name: Sasol Delight
company.distributes: Forecourt convenience stores selling packaged snacks (Lay's, Simba, Doritos, peanuts and raisins), drinks, bakery items and daily essentials
company.channels_supplied: Sasol Delight convenience stores on Sasol forecourts across South Africa, with partner outlets such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme
what_they_do_well: Runs in-store promotions with major snack brands such as Simba and Doritos across its national Delight stores.
Adding partner brands such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme to its convenience centres since 2023.
company.fit_rationale: A national petrol station convenience chain that sells branded packaged snacks from other companies to shoppers on the go, shown by its Lay's, Simba and Doritos promotion. Store count is not stated on its website, which refers to Delight stores across the nation. It has a franchise programme and a supplier management office.

company.name: SJ Florist (Begifted)
company.distributes: Chocolate hampers with branded chocolate bars and slabs (Lindt Excellence, Cadbury) and gifts
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its online shop and florist in Gqeberha
company.fit_rationale: A Gqeberha florist and gift shop whose hampers and gifts section sells branded chocolate from Lindt and Cadbury. Diablo's chocolate bars and gift boxes would fit its chocolate hampers for Valentine's, Mother's Day and Father's Day. Tier 3 as a single-city shop.

company.name: Sportsmans Warehouse
company.distributes: Sports equipment, clothing and footwear plus a supplements section with protein bars (USN Protein Bar, USN Pro Protein Bar) and a snacks category
company.channels_supplied: Its own sports stores across South Africa (store locator on its website) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Sells leading sports brands such as ASICS, Nike and Garmin alongside USN nutrition in stores and online.
company.fit_rationale: A national sports retailer with a supplements and snacks section that sells protein bars from other brands such as USN to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and cookies suit its endurance and fitness shoppers. Store count is not stated on the pages seen.

company.name: Superb Hyper (Superb Cash and Carry)
company.distributes: FMCG with branded sweets, chocolate bars, chewing gum and biscuit bars (Twix, Manhattan, Mister Sweet, Clorets, Candy Land) including trade case packs
company.channels_supplied: Households and trade customers through its KwaDukuza store, a retail web shop and the superbbulk.co.za wholesale site with traders deals
what_they_do_well: Family business since 1974, Superb Cash and Carry since 1985, hybrid wholesale and retail since 2008 and online delivery since 2022.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run hybrid wholesaler and retailer, a cash and carry since 1985, whose own web shop lists many branded sweets and chocolates in single and trade case packs. It serves traders north of Durban with bulk buying and online delivery. Storage: sells from its own stock at its KwaDukuza cash and carry store with online delivery, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Sweeto Africa
company.distributes: Halal certified Turkish confectionery: marshmallows, jelly gummies and liquorice from the Sweeto brand
company.channels_supplied: Wholesale and trade customers in South Africa and neighbouring countries through trading accounts and local distribution partners
what_they_do_well: Distributes the Sweeto halal confectionery range across South Africa and surrounding countries through local distribution partners.
company.fit_rationale: A Durban wholesaler and distributor of 100% halal Turkish sweets and gummies that opens trading accounts with shops, which matches the channel model of a halal importer supplying the trade with branded confectionery. Diablo's halal certified gummies and jelly sweets sit next to its range. Storage: sells from its own stock to trade accounts, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Sweets Brands
company.distributes: Chocolates, candies, mints and snacks from imported brands (Tayas, Solen, Pengo, Endearmints)
company.channels_supplied: Trade customers only: supermarket chains, convenience stores, online stores and independent retailers across Southern Africa
company.fit_rationale: A trade-only FMCG distributor of imported confectionery for convenience stores and independents, trading since 2010. Tier 3 because its website names no address, warehouse or customer names. Storage: sells from its own stock through its web shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: The Vending Company
company.distributes: Snack vending with confectionery and beverages
company.channels_supplied: Offices, call centres and companies, plus independent vending operators across Africa
what_they_do_well: More than 18 years in vending, with in-house merchandisers stocking machines.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned vending operator that runs a fully managed service with its own merchandisers stocking confectionery in workplace machines, and supports independent operators. Its website does not name the brands it stocks or its head office city. Storage: buys and holds the stock its merchandisers load, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: The Vending Guys
company.distributes: Chocolate (Aero), snacks (Doritos), cakes (Tinkies), breakfast bars and drinks in rented vending machines
company.channels_supplied: Vending machines in offices, call centres, schools, gyms, hospitals, malls, hotels, hostels, airports, factories and transport hubs across Cape Town
what_they_do_well: Names Coca-Cola, Doritos and Aero as best-sellers and offers stock checks, cleaning and refunds as part of its service.
company.fit_rationale: An owner-run Cape Town operator that rents, stocks, packs and maintains its machines and names branded chocolate, snacks and cakes as best-sellers. It tailors the mix to each site, so Diablo's chocolate, cakes and bars can be trialled machine by machine. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: TLC Pantry (The Low Carb Pantry)
company.channel: Diabetic, low sugar and keto shops
company.distributes: Low carb, keto, banting and sugar free foods: sugar free sweets and chocolate (Caring Candies), biscuits and biscotti (Gracious Bakers, Skinny Biscotti), jams (Leo's Little Jars), cakes, cookies, syrups, keto chips and breakfast bars
company.channels_supplied: Its own shops in Bloubergstrand, Tyger Valley, Somerset West and Tokai, plus its own online shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Caring Candies, Gracious Bakers, Skinny Biscotti, Leo's Little Jars, We Love Low Carb, Ketos
what_they_do_well: Runs four low carb shops across Cape Town (Bloubergstrand, Tyger Valley, Somerset West, Tokai) as well as an online shop.
company.fit_rationale: A four-store Cape Town specialist for low carb, keto, banting and sugar free shoppers that already sells other brands' sugar free sweets, chocolate, biscuits and jams. Diablo's sugar free chocolate, biscuits, spreads and syrups match the shelves it already has. Caring Candies competes directly in sugar free sweets and chocolate.

contacts.job_title: Managing Director TotalEnergies EP Nigeria and Country Chair

company.name: TotalEnergies Marketing South Africa (Cafe Bonjour shops)
company.distributes: Snacks, drinks, groceries and hygiene products in its station shops, plus pastries, sandwiches and pies in Cafe Bonjour
company.channels_supplied: Cafe Bonjour shops at TotalEnergies service stations nationwide; some sites host OK Express stores
what_they_do_well: Runs one of South Africa's larger forecourt networks, with over 547 service stations as of 2025.
company.fit_rationale: Its own website says its station stores sell snacks, drinks and groceries alongside the Cafe Bonjour counter, across a network of over 547 service stations. The shop brand is run under one national banner, so it offers a central route into forecourt shops; the number of stations with a Bonjour shop and the buying model are not stated on its website.

company.name: Turkish Grand Bazaar
company.distributes: Imported Turkish sweets and chocolate: Turkish delight gift boxes, Dubai chocolate, chocolate coated dragees, baklava and dried fruit, from Turkish brands such as Cerez Pazari, Musko and Bolci
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with courier delivery, plus a wholesale page for trade buyers
what_they_do_well: Imports baklava and Turkish delight straight from Turkey and sells them nationally online, with a separate wholesale offer.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town online shop importing branded Turkish sweets, Dubai chocolate and dragees, products bought by the Muslim and Turkish shoppers this channel targets. Diablo's Dubai style chocolate, chocolate dragees and gift boxes match its best selling lines. Tier 3 because it is one online shop and its website does not state halal certification or how many trade buyers it supplies.

company.name: USA Imports Gauteng
company.distributes: Imported branded sweets, chocolate, candy and biscuits (Reese's, Hershey's, Nerds, Sour Patch, Pop Rocks, Dubble Bubble, Oreo) plus drinks
company.channels_supplied: 573 trade customers including SPAR South Rand and SPAR North Rand stores
what_they_do_well: Serves 573 customers with about 1,024 product lines (2023).
Listed as a supplier with SPAR North Rand since 2013 and SPAR South Rand since 2021.
company.fit_rationale: An importer and wholesaler with about 1,024 product lines and a trade order sheet, selling foreign branded sweets and biscuits to retailers. It shares its Halfway House address with Artistic Visual Agency, so outreach should be coordinated. Storage: own warehouse in Midrand, moved there in 2022.

company.name: Xtreme Nutrition
company.distributes: Protein bars, flapjacks, high protein cookies, protein wafers and powdered peanut butter from Barebells, Applied Nutrition, Grenade and PB2, plus sports nutrition
company.channels_supplied: Its own chain of over 25 stores and online shop, plus wholesale accounts for other businesses
company.sf_brands_carried: Barebells and Grenade Carb Killa protein bars; no direct competitor in sugar-free confectionery seen
what_they_do_well: Runs more than 25 sports nutrition stores across South Africa plus an online shop.
company.fit_rationale: A sports nutrition chain that sells bars, cookies, wafers and spreads from UK and European brands to health-conscious shoppers and wholesales its exclusive brands to other businesses. Get Raw Nutrition names it as its South African distributor. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Yabulela Gift Hampers
company.distributes: Gift hampers with biscuits, nougat bars, fudge, chocolate-coated treats, sugar sweets and chocolate, including kosher and halal hampers
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate clients nationwide by courier, plus custom-packed event hampers
company.sf_brands_carried: Offers diabetic and banting hampers on request
what_they_do_well: Offers kosher, halal and diabetic hampers and has packed corporate hampers since about 2010.
company.fit_rationale: A corporate and consumer hamper company that packs biscuits, nougat, fudge and sweets bought from local suppliers into kosher, halal and corporate hampers. It already makes diabetic hampers on request, a natural home for Diablo's no-added-sugar range. Diablo's halal certificate and kosher products also suit its kosher and halal lines.

company.name: Your Gifts
company.distributes: Snack and chocolate hampers with Cadbury, Nestle, Kit Kat, Aero, Lindt, Whispers, Bar One and Milkybar, plus Mini Marie and Tennis biscuits and nougat
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online from Pretoria North
company.fit_rationale: A small Pretoria online hamper shop whose snack and chocolate hampers are made up entirely of other companies' chocolate and biscuit brands. It is tier 3 because it is small and its website does not mention corporate orders.

company.name: Bash (TFG)
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Racefood (Fastbar and Farbar) and sports nutrition from 32Gi and Gloot in its sports and wellness departments
company.channels_supplied: Online shop of TFG, selling for chains including Totalsports and Sportscene
what_they_do_well: Sells for 19 TFG store brands, including Totalsports and Sportscene, from one online shop.
company.fit_rationale: TFG's online store sells sports goods for Totalsports and Sportscene and already lists Racefood bars and 32Gi nutrition. Diablo's bars and sugar-free snacks would sit alongside them for sport shoppers. Head office city taken from TFG's public profile; food range is small.

company.name: Big Five Duty Free
company.distributes: Duty free retail of liquor, fragrance, cosmetics, tobacco, accessories and confectionery, including chocolate (for example Amarula chocolate and milk chocolate lines)
company.channels_supplied: Its own duty free stores in international departures and arrivals at OR Tambo, Cape Town, King Shaka and Lanseria airports, plus online pre-order with in-store collection
what_they_do_well: Described by the Moodie Davitt Report in October 2025 as Sub-Saharan Africa's leading travel retail operator.
Launched Distell's Amarula chocolate in its airport stores (2023).
company.fit_rationale: The leading duty free operator in South Africa, with stores at the four main international airports and confectionery named as one of its core categories on its own About page. Gebr. Heinemann is a co-shareholder, bringing global confectionery buying, and the OR Tambo revamp is premiumising the confectionery offer, which suits Diablo's gift boxes, chocolate and seasonal packs. No sugar-free range is shown on its website.

company.name: Cape Union Mart
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Snacks and energy bars in its Snacks & Nutrition section, including Racefood bars
company.channels_supplied: Own outdoor and adventure stores in malls across South Africa (Canal Walk, Cavendish, Fourways Mall, Woodlands) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Racefood lists Cape Union Mart among its national retailers for energy bars.
company.fit_rationale: A national outdoor and travel chain with its own Snacks & Nutrition category, and Racefood names it as a stockist of its bars. Diablo's muesli bars, cookies and sugar-free sweets suit hikers and travellers. Products in the category did not load in this run, so brands beyond Racefood are not listed here.

company.name: Fabulous Flowers and Gifts
company.distributes: Chocolate and sweets gift boxes (Lindt, Lindt Lindor, Ferrero Rocher), luxury biscuits, nougat, jams and snack hampers
company.channels_supplied: Own shops in Claremont, Cavendish Square and Sea Point, a Johannesburg branch, nationwide online delivery and corporate accounts
what_they_do_well: Hand-packing chocolate and sweets boxes in its Claremont studio since 1999, with over 5,000 customer reviews.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town gifting business with its own shops, a Johannesburg branch and corporate accounts for banks, law firms and agencies, whose chocolate and sweets boxes are built on Lindt and Ferrero Rocher. Shelf-stable boxes ship nationwide, which suits Diablo's ambient gift boxes. Its sister brand Flower Guy sells the same kind of hampers with Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury and Darling Sweet.

company.name: HealthTwin Supplements & Vitamins
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Barebells protein bars, Creme Supreme and Gloot products, sports nutrition and vitamins
company.channels_supplied: One store at Mall @ Reds, Centurion, and its own online shop with delivery across South Africa
company.fit_rationale: An independent sports nutrition retailer that sells Barebells protein bars and other brands to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's sugar-free bars and cookies fit its shelf. Small, one store.

company.name: Kit Kat Group (Kit Kat Cash and Carry)
company.distributes: Groceries and FMCG with web shop categories for sweets, chocolate products, snack foods and sweet and snacks
company.channels_supplied: Traders, spaza shops and households through cash and carry stores and Express stores in Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga, plus an online store
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1953, with wholesale since 1983; now runs 6 cash and carry stores, 19 Express stores and 3 Express cash and carry stores.
company.fit_rationale: A family-owned cash and carry group whose own web shop lists sweets, chocolate and snack categories sold in trade pack sizes to traders and shoppers. Its stores feed many independent and informal retailers in Gauteng and Limpopo, a direct route to spaza and tuck shop shelves. Storage: cash and carry stores, including a 20,000 m2 Pretoria West site, served by its own fleet of warehouse trucks.

company.name: LuluLocal
company.distributes: Curated gifts with sweets and chocolates, biscuits and rusks, and dried fruit and savoury snacks from local brands
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers online and corporate gifting for year-end, conferences and activations nationwide
what_they_do_well: Holds its own stock for fast daily turnaround and scales to conference and year-end gifting projects.
company.fit_rationale: An online gift shop and corporate gifting service that sells other South African brands' sweets, chocolates and biscuits and builds bespoke corporate boxes. It holds its own stock for daily turnaround and handles nationwide delivery, so it can take a branded imported range. Head office address and warehouse are not named on its website; it states that it holds stock.

company.name: NetFlorist
company.distributes: Chocolate gift boxes, hat boxes, crates, towers and truffles (Lindt, Nestle, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury), nougat (Sally Williams), candy jars, cookies and snack hampers
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers and corporate buyers nationwide through its own online shop and delivery network
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1999 and runs its own warehouses and in-house delivery hubs in four South African cities.
company.fit_rationale: South Africa's largest online gifting business, with chocolate and snack hampers built from other companies' brands such as Lindt, Ferrero Rocher and Cadbury. A branded sugar-free chocolate box or variety pack would sit naturally in its chocolate gift categories. Storage: own warehouses in Johannesburg and Cape Town, with in-house logistics hubs in Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria and Johannesburg.

company.name: OfficeBox
company.distributes: Office supplies with a kitchen and breakroom range: biscuits (Bakers, Mantellis, Eet-Sum-Mor), chocolate and sweets (Nestle Bar One, Endearmints, Beacon), cereal and energy bars (Jungle), peanut butter (Black Cat) and savoury snacks (Simba, Lay's).
company.channels_supplied: Businesses and offices through its online shop and B2B procurement accounts, with next-day delivery in Johannesburg and Cape Town and national delivery to multi-branch clients such as Virgin Active and Burger King.
what_they_do_well: Supplies multi-branch clients nationally; testimonials cite Virgin Active (155 branches) and Burger King (95 stores).
Next-day delivery in Johannesburg and Cape Town for orders placed by 9:30am.
company.fit_rationale: An online office supplier with a 55-item biscuits and snacks collection of other companies' brands, sold to offices and multi-branch businesses nationally. Diablo's biscuits, chocolate, bars and spreads sit in the exact shelf it already runs for office kitchens. Storage: sells from its own stock of 6,500+ products with next-day delivery, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Olympic Cycles
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Energy bars from Amacx, Cadence, Enduren, GU, HIGH5, Isostar, Maurten, Nutritech, PowerBar, Racefood and Voom, plus gels
company.channels_supplied: Two cycling stores (Claremont and Kenilworth) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Runs one of the widest bar ranges seen in South African cycling retail, with eleven bar brands.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town cycling retailer with a dedicated bars collection of eleven brands sold online nationwide. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars would fit this shelf. Only two stores are shown.

company.name: Sasol Delight
company.distributes: Forecourt convenience stores selling packaged snacks (Lay's, Simba, Doritos, peanuts and raisins), drinks, bakery items and daily essentials
company.channels_supplied: Sasol Delight convenience stores on Sasol forecourts across South Africa, with partner outlets such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme
what_they_do_well: Runs in-store promotions with major snack brands such as Simba and Doritos across its national Delight stores.
Adding partner brands such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme to its convenience centres since 2023.
company.fit_rationale: A national petrol station convenience chain that sells branded packaged snacks from other companies to shoppers on the go, shown by its Lay's, Simba and Doritos promotion. Store count is not stated on its website, which refers to Delight stores across the nation. It has a franchise programme and a supplier management office.

company.name: Sportsmans Warehouse
company.distributes: Sports equipment, clothing and footwear plus a supplements section with protein bars (USN Protein Bar, USN Pro Protein Bar) and a snacks category
company.channels_supplied: Its own sports stores across South Africa (store locator on its website) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Sells leading sports brands such as ASICS, Nike and Garmin alongside USN nutrition in stores and online.
company.fit_rationale: A national sports retailer with a supplements and snacks section that sells protein bars from other brands such as USN to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and cookies suit its endurance and fitness shoppers. Store count is not stated on the pages seen.

company.name: The Vending Company
company.distributes: Snack vending with confectionery and beverages
company.channels_supplied: Offices, call centres and companies, plus independent vending operators across Africa
what_they_do_well: More than 18 years in vending, with in-house merchandisers stocking machines.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned vending operator that runs a fully managed service with its own merchandisers stocking confectionery in workplace machines, and supports independent operators. Its website does not name the brands it stocks or its head office city. Storage: buys and holds the stock its merchandisers load, warehouse not named on its website.

company.channels_supplied: Cafe Bonjour shops at TotalEnergies service stations nationwide; some sites host OK Express stores
